title: the-librarian-chats
intention: The librarian's chat window CHATS: a resolve turn's reply is conversational prose rendered FROM the graph's walk — generate spent on articulation, never on routing and never on free facts — with the core loop's verdict riding the turn as data and collapsing to a secondary line at the surface.
why: Akien, 2026-08-09, after the first real conversation attempt ('hello' answered with 'UNRESOLVED (no_progress) · best 0.5548 · floor 0.65 · 2 backfills · 2 nodes folded in' and a ranked node list): 'regardless of the specifics, the intentions say it should be chatting and it's not. bring it in line with its intentions.' The first-face ruling (2026-07-27) says CHAT BOT — 'the librarian as chat bot, learning, and summarizing. learning always and summarizing when asked' — and the build kept the word while replacing the meaning: charter falsifier (15) pinned the reply to the raw walk, so the window diagnoses instead of conversing. The lived symptom is a human saying hello to a wall of resolution mechanics.

falsifier.proves_red: RED if: a resolve reply at /device/librarian is still a diagnostics dump instead of prose; or the reply asserts library content the walk never held (a citation the walk cannot anchor, or prose claiming grounding it does not have); or routing spends inference (the summarize: prefix stays the physics); or the loop's verdict data goes missing from the turn record (the surface may collapse it, the record may not lose it). Horizon: proved at build + one live fire through the browser door; the standing measure is Akien's next real conversation at the window.
